public_view_definition:
SELECT ((r.result -> 'rows'::text) -> 0) -> 'payload'::text AS payload
   FROM estudo.notebook_runs r
     JOIN estudo.produtos p ON p.codigo = 'previa-2026-q3'::text AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND p.publicacao_id = 41
  WHERE r.id = 239 AND r.cell_id = 420 AND r.frozen AND r.status = 'ok'::text AND NOT r.truncated AND r.row_count = 1;
